items_all.title: Replit 发布 Monitoring Agent，为应用提供可自动修复并部署的值班智能体
items_all.summary: Replit 发布 Monitoring Agent，为应用提供相当于自主值班工程师的监控智能体。它可以读取生产日志和指标调查错误、变慢和部署失败，在启用 autofix 后验证修复并邮件汇报，启用 auto-publish 后可自动部署修复。该能力建立在早前上线的 App Monitoring 之上，用户可在应用的 Publishing 设置中开启。
items_all.title_original: Replit Monitoring Agent: Your very own software engineering team
items_all.title_en: Replit Monitoring Agent: Your very own software engineering team
items_all.title_zh: Replit 发布 Monitoring Agent，为应用提供可自动修复并部署的值班智能体
items_all.title_bilingual: Replit 发布 Monitoring Agent，为应用提供可自动修复并部署的值班智能体 / Replit Monitoring Agent: Your very own software engineering team

en.summary: Replit has launched Monitoring Agent, a monitoring agent that serves as an autonomous on-call engineer for apps. It reads production logs and metrics to investigate errors, slowdowns, and failed deployments; with autofix enabled, it verifies fixes and reports back by email, and with auto-publish enabled it can deploy fixes automatically. The capability builds on the earlier App Monitoring launch, and users can turn it on in an app's Publishing settings.

items_all.title: Claude 网页、桌面和移动端将默认启用 auto mode
items_all.summary: Claude 官方宣布，下周起 Pro、Max 和 Team 套餐在 Claude 网页、桌面和移动端应用中的会话将默认以 auto mode 运行。auto mode 不再逐步请求用户批准，而是由自动检查拦截高风险操作，用户可随时切回手动模式。其引用的 Claude Code 更新提到 auto mode 用独立分类器审查 shell 命令，测试中拦截了 89% 的危险命令，手动批准为 14%。
items_all.title_original: Starting next week, sessions across Claude web, desktop, and mobile apps will run in auto mode by default on Pro, Max, and Team plans.
items_all.title_en: Starting next week, sessions across Claude web, desktop, and mobile apps will run in auto mode by default on Pro, Max, and Team plans.
items_all.title_zh: Claude 网页、桌面和移动端将默认启用 auto mode
items_all.title_bilingual: Claude 网页、桌面和移动端将默认启用 auto mode / Starting next week, sessions across Claude web, desktop, and mobile apps will run in auto mode by default on Pro, Max, and Team plans.

en.summary: Claude officially announced that starting next week, sessions on the Pro, Max, and Team plans across the Claude web, desktop, and mobile apps will run in auto mode by default. Auto mode no longer asks for user approval at each step; instead, automated checks block high-risk actions, and users can switch back to manual mode at any time. The Claude Code update it cites notes that auto mode uses a separate classifier to review shell commands, intercepting 89% of dangerous commands in testing, compared with 14% for manual approval.

items_all.title: Anthropic 股权表内幕：风投迟到多年，如今无人持股超 2%
items_all.summary: Newcomer 长文复盘 Anthropic 从 OpenAI 出走团队到即将 IPO 的股权演变。据投资人文件和多位知情人士，多年来风投因公司治理结构和安全优先路线而观望，目前没有任何风投机构持股超过 2%，Anthropic 曾向投资人明确将单一投资人持股控制在该水平以避免话语权集中。
items_all.title_original: The Story of Anthropic’s Cap Table: VCs Showed Up Late to the Party, Toting All the Cash They Could Wrangle
items_all.title_en: The Story of Anthropic’s Cap Table: VCs Showed Up Late to the Party, Toting All the Cash They Could Wrangle

items_all.title_bilingual: Anthropic 股权表内幕：风投迟到多年，如今无人持股超 2% / The Story of Anthropic’s Cap Table: VCs Showed Up Late to the Party, Toting All the Cash They Could Wrangle

en.summary: In a long-form retrospective, Newcomer traces Anthropic’s equity evolution from an OpenAI breakaway team to an imminent IPO. According to investor documents and multiple people familiar with the matter, VCs stayed on the sidelines for years due to the company’s governance structure and safety-first approach; no VC firm currently holds more than 2%. Anthropic had explicitly told investors it would cap any single investor’s stake at that level to avoid a concentration of influence.

items_all.title: PHP2Shell 漏洞披露前黑客已有四天窗口，多国机构紧急响应
items_all.summary: PHP2Shell 漏洞在被披露前四天已遭黑客利用，Calif 与 Wiz 的研究人员发现这些漏洞。OpenAI 称其前沿 AI 在攻击者之前发现了漏洞，并与 PHP、Calif、Wiz 合作验证并开发补丁。NSA 建议无法立即更新的机构将系统离线，英国 NCSC 表示漏洞可能让黑客无需登录凭据即可控制网站服务器，白宫称联邦机构正在评估对政府系统和关键基础设施的潜在影响。
items_all.title_original: Hackers got a four-day head start on epic PHP2Shell vulnerability
items_all.title_en: Hackers got a four-day head start on epic PHP2Shell vulnerability
items_all.title_zh: PHP2Shell 漏洞披露前黑客已有四天窗口，多国机构紧急响应
items_all.title_bilingual: PHP2Shell 漏洞披露前黑客已有四天窗口，多国机构紧急响应 / Hackers got a four-day head start on epic PHP2Shell vulnerability

en.summary: The PHP2Shell vulnerability was already being exploited by hackers four days before it was disclosed, with researchers at Calif and Wiz discovering the flaws. OpenAI says its frontier AI found the vulnerability before attackers did and worked with PHP, Calif, and Wiz to verify it and develop a patch. The NSA advises organizations unable to update immediately to take systems offline, while the UK's NCSC said the flaw could let hackers take control of web servers without login credentials. The White House said federal agencies are assessing the potential impact on government systems and critical infrastructure.

items_all.title: 404 Media 分析 PHP2Shell 事件如何改变 AI 时代的攻防格局
items_all.summary: 404 Media 的 Jason Koebler 梳理近一个月安全专家对 AI 挖洞能力引发的"Black October"恐慌。Wiz、Calif 和 OpenAI 的研究者用 AI 发现了 PHP 的 PHP2Shell 漏洞，Cloudflare CEO 称公开公告前 10 小时已见数千次利用尝试，公告后 2 小时内增至数十万，目前达数百万级。
items_all.title_original: AI Is Changing Everything About Hacking. No One Knows What Happens Next
items_all.title_en: AI Is Changing Everything About Hacking. No One Knows What Happens Next
items_all.title_zh: 404 Media 分析 PHP2Shell 事件如何改变 AI 时代的攻防格局
items_all.title_bilingual: 404 Media 分析 PHP2Shell 事件如何改变 AI 时代的攻防格局 / AI Is Changing Everything About Hacking. No One Knows What Happens Next

en.summary: 404 Media’s Jason Koebler rounds up a month of security experts’ alarm over a “Black October” driven by AI’s vulnerability-hunting capabilities. Researchers at Wiz, Calif, and OpenAI used AI to discover PHP’s PHP2Shell vulnerability. Cloudflare’s CEO said thousands of exploitation attempts were seen 10 hours before the public disclosure, hundreds of thousands within 2 hours after it, and millions by now.

items_all.summary: 可灵（Kling）宣布 Kling 4.0 已在 OnSolo 上线。该模型支持单次生成 30 秒原生视频，快速动作和大运镜下保持稳定，立体声配更准的口型同步，并提供 21:9 宽屏，单个任务可叠加最多 15 个参考图和 10 个关键帧以保持角色、镜头与剧情一致。

en.summary: Kling has announced that Kling 4.0 is now live on OnSolo. The model can generate 30-second native video in a single pass, stays stable through fast action and large camera moves, offers stereo audio with more accurate lip sync, and supports a 21:9 widescreen format. A single task can stack up to 15 reference images and 10 keyframes to keep characters, shots and storyline consistent.

The fundraising target was raised at least twice during negotiations, from about $7.5 billion to $12 billion; CATL and Tencent are among the largest investors, with CATL reportedly contributing about $1.5 billion. The pre-money valuation is about $74.8 billion. Including a first round of more than $7.5 billion completed in June, DeepSeek has raised about $22.5 billion in roughly six months.

en.summary: The author walks through the full arc of two PHP remote code execution vulnerabilities that started at a perfect CVSS score (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, together known as PHP2Shell) — from the early leak and the demo video that surfaced, to government websites in multiple countries going offline as a precaution, and finally the patch going live at 10 p.m. on the 21st. en.summary: Anthropic's Applied AI team published a guide on when to consolidate an orchestrator's router, planner, and domain sub-agents into a single main Agent loop. en.summary: Anthropic has released Claude Duet, a standalone Persoal Agent App that proactively organizes to-dos, flags anomalies, and prepares materials. en.summary: Many people building Agents focus only on expanding capabilities while neglecting constraint boundaries, so a casual user instruction can easily derail the task. The author offers a practical closed-loop design: a boundary mechanism built on goal definition, state routing, deviation correction, and termination criteria, along with a Skill file structure and an approach to exception testing.

items_all.title: 一文讲透26年AI产品经理必懂的Agent分类
items_all.summary: AI Agent岗位越招越多，看着都叫“智能体”，背后的技术门槛、业务价值和职业风险却完全不同，选错方向，很可能刚转型就撞上大模型升级带来的淘汰。作者把编程、办公、深度研究、内容创作、流程自动化、客服、营销和行业 Agent 八条赛道逐一拆开，讲清了它们的运行逻辑、岗位需求与常见坑点。别只追最热概念，带上原有行业经验，去解决离业务和收入更近的问题，才更容易做出长期壁垒。

en.title: A Complete Guide to the Agent Classifications Every AI Product Manager Must Know in 2026
en.summary: AI Agent job postings keep multiplying, and they all look like "agents" on the surface—but the technical bar, business value, and career risk behind them are completely different. Pick the wrong track and you may barely finish your transition before the next LLM upgrade makes your role obsolete. The author breaks down eight tracks one by one—coding, office productivity, deep research, content creation, workflow automation, customer service, marketing, and industry-specific agents—explaining how each actually works, what the roles demand, and the common pitfalls. Don't just chase the hottest buzzword; bring your existing industry experience and solve problems closer to the business and revenue, and you'll be more likely to build a lasting moat.

items_all.title: 目前的 Harness 优化，有两个大方向。 一统全局脚手架，试图用一套Prompt 和控制逻辑。但随着业务场景增加，针对财务表格优化的指令往往会干扰代码生成任务，导致严重的规则冲突与上下文过度膨胀。 另一种是针对每个特定领域单独复制一份专用代码。然而不同版本之间无法代码复用，维护起来很难。而且一旦遇到未曾见过的分布外（OOD）新任务，专用脚本往往会崩溃，且无法回退。 其实人类软件工程早在 40 年前，就用面向对象编程完美解决了复用、…

items_all_raw.summary: PHP2Shell 漏洞在被披露前四天已遭黑客利用，Calif 与 Wiz 的研究人员发现这些漏洞。OpenAI 称其前沿 AI 在攻击者之前发现了漏洞，并与 PHP、Calif、Wiz 合作验证并开发补丁。NSA 建议无法立即更新的机构将系统离线，英国 NCSC 表示漏洞可能让黑客无需登录凭据即可控制网站服务器，白宫称联邦机构正在评估对政府系统和关键基础设施的潜在影响。

items_all_raw.summary: 可灵（Kling）宣布 Kling 4.0 已在 OnSolo 上线。该模型支持单次生成 30 秒原生视频，快速动作和大运镜下保持稳定，立体声配更准的口型同步，并提供 21:9 宽屏，单个任务可叠加最多 15 个参考图和 10 个关键帧以保持角色、镜头与剧情一致。

items_all_raw.title: Bloomberg 报道 DeepSeek 新一轮融资约 150 亿美元
items_all_raw.summary: 据 Bloomberg，DeepSeek 最新一轮融资约 150 亿美元，为中国最大规模私募融资之一。谈判期间融资目标至少两次上调，从约 75 亿美元提高到 120 亿美元；CATL 和腾讯是最大投资方之一，CATL 据报出资约 15 亿美元。投前估值约 748 亿美元，加上 6 月完成的首轮超 75 亿美元，DeepSeek 约 6 个月内共募资约 225 亿美元。

items_all_raw.title: 目前的 Harness 优化，有两个大方向。 一统全局脚手架，试图用一套Prompt 和控制逻辑。但随着业务场景增加，针对财务表格优化的指令往往会干扰代码生成任务，导致严重的规则冲突与上下文过度膨胀。 另一种是针对每个特定领域单独复制一份专用代码。然而不同版本之间无法代码复用，维护起来很难。而且一旦遇到未曾见过的分布外（OOD）新任务，专用脚本往往会崩溃，且无法回退。 其实人类软件工程早在 40 年前，就用面向对象编程完美解决了复用、…
